text:
Jules (People Ops): Heads-up: Rafael's birthday is Monday 2026-09-14. Thinking low-key: bring-your-own-lunch meetup at 12:30 + group e-card, or we do a tiny decorating kit (cupcakes + sprinkles) so people can decorate at their desks? vote with emoji :tada:
Rafael: I'm easy — honestly just the card and a hi are enough. don't go overboard.
Hana: Decorating kit sounds adorable but messy. maybe individual mini cupcakes in boxes?
Priyanka: Mini cupcakes + labeled allergy tags please (no nuts).
Owen: If folks are remote, we could also do a $15 charity donation option in lieu of swag — cc remote friends?
Bea: Love the charity idea. Could have two options: donate or cupcakes + card.
Samir: Remote here  I'll donate. Can we post a link?
hr-bot: Reminder: please include ingredient and allergen info on shared food. No open flames or candles in common areas per safety policy.
Jules (People Ops): OK plan: mini boxed cupcakes (vegan & GF options) on Rafael's desk + e-card. Optional charity pool for remote folks ($15 suggested). I'll post payment links and a calendar stub for 12:25-12:40. Any objections?
Rafael: Perfect, thank you! Really appreciate low-key.
Hana: I'll pick up cupcakes and the little boxes. ETA 12:10 to set up.
Priyanka: I'll make the e-card note. Who wants to add messages?
Owen: Posting donation link now: https://give.example/org/rafe-bday (send $15 or whatever works).
Bea: Sent $15 via pool (https://pay.example/giftpool/rafael).
Samir: Donated $15 to the charity link.
Jules (People Ops): Calendar invite "Rafael - quick drop-in" 12:25-12:40 created. Card on the shelf, cupcakes on main table. If you're remote, jump on cam at 12:30 for a quick hello.
Priyanka: Also adding sticky note labels (vegan, GF, contains dairy).
Owen: RSVP: popping by at 12:30.
Jules (People Ops): Thanks everyone 3fb will update if anything changes.
